title: I was stuck at $100 for 2 years until I made one change. Now my app makes $10K/month
description:
Piotr built Visualizee, an AI rendering tool that lets architects and designers generate realistic home renders in seconds. This might sound like a success story... but Piotr was stuck at $150 per month for YEARS. Then, one single product pivot changed his entire business and grew it to $10K per month. 
*The AI Playbook: 50+ AI app ideas making millions:* https://clickhubspot.com/qs4m

Say hi to Piotr: https://x.com/pobidowski
Check out Visualizee: https://visualizee.ai/
